about: The catalog configuration audit rules. scripts/config_audit.py reads this file, so change a threshold or word list here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes; references/checks.md says what each check means.

notes.internal_words: Words in an attribute name that mark internal commercial data. An internal attribute that is displayable (returned in API responses, so visible in the page source) or facetable is high; searchable is medium.
notes.must_be_searchable: Reserved or core attributes that should be searchable, with the priority when they aren't (reserved_attribute_searchability and core_attribute_searchability in the config).
notes.numeric_reserved: Reserved numeric attributes. Searchable means a query like '70' matches every product with that value: low, review.
notes.id_words: Words in a custom attribute name that mark an identifier. A searchable identifier is low: fine if shoppers search by code, noise otherwise.
notes.reserved_prefixes: Prefixes stripped from a custom attribute name before comparing it with reserved names, so product_brand is seen to duplicate brand.
notes.key_reserved: Reserved attributes every product needs, with the priority when the sample's fill rate is below key_min_fill.
notes.key_min_fill: Share of sampled products that must have a key reserved attribute (non-empty).
notes.custom_min_fill: A configured custom attribute filled on fewer than this share of sampled products is reported (medium if it is facetable or searchable, low otherwise; 0 means configured but never filled).
notes.min_sample: Fewer sampled products than this and fill rates are reported as rough, with a not_checked note.
notes.max_suggest_min_chars: Autosuggest that waits for more characters than this before suggesting is low.
notes.max_drop_threshold: An index search_docs_drop_threshold above this is medium: if it is the percentage of products a feed may remove before indexing stops, a broken feed could empty search.
notes.stale_index_days: A production catalog whose last index refresh is older than this many days (against --today) is medium; hand off to data-feed-health.
notes.core_fields: Feed fields that are neither custom nor reserved configuration, so they're never reported as unconfigured.
notes.list_limit: At most this many attribute names are quoted in one finding.
